# Lorem Ipsum Ai MCP

> MEOK AI Labs — Generate placeholder text in various styles

`lorem-ipsum-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install lorem-ipsum-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx lorem-ipsum-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `generate_paragraphs` — Generate placeholder paragraphs. Styles: lorem (classic), tech, business, nature, food.
- `generate_sentences` — Generate individual placeholder sentences with configurable length.
- `generate_words` — Generate a specific number of placeholder words.
- `generate_structured` — Generate structured placeholder content. Templates: article, email, list, table, form, card.
